description: The videos primarily analyze and debunk viral videos that appear 'too good to be true', such as paranormal clips, UFO sightings, and impossible stunts, by using the creator's professional visual effects expertise to break down how the illusions were digitally created. While the channel originally focused on exposing internet hoaxes, it has also expanded to include educational breakdowns of visual effects techniques used in films and demonstrations of how to recreate specific illusions.
